timing_limit: The legacy timer stopped accumulating at its cap while labels could still be saved. Zero times after the cap are missing durations, not instant reviews. The final positive-duration item is conservatively treated as censored. Timing comparisons are unvalidated.
scope: Single-reviewer English public-document interface study. Layouts use different matched questions. Visible-page time includes possible idle time and excludes reading before Start; 500ms timing resolution. Missing or time-stopped items can bias completion.
review_cost_claim: Descriptive subset only. No general time-saving or Hindi attribution claim.
automatic_release_risk: Insufficient evidence: no calibrated candidate releases in this study

self_reported_active_review_minutes.basis: Reviewer estimate, with unquantified interruptions; not instrumented active time

protocol_deviation: Reviewer continued labeling after the requested 20-minute cap; legacy UI allowed this while its timer stopped accumulating.

budget_accounting.basis: Charge the full elapsed review interval because interruptions were not timed. Separate public-label audit budget is unchanged.

human_vs_em_interpretation: Single-reviewer judgments, not adjudicated gold. Disagreements can reflect reference aliases, partial-answer acceptance, reference problems or reviewer error. No public-label error rate is inferred.
